missing.scope: Only momentum3 andpullback6; no volume/VWAP input or imputation. Original missing reason retained.
missing.median: Observed finite feature values in actual eligible FIT rows only, weighted by training w_i and renormalized over observed. Sort value theneventId; choose smallest observed value whose cumulative weight>=0.5. No outcome value enters median; no evaluation/past-calibration labels/features in fitted statistics.
missing.sourceMapping: AVAILABLE requires finite valid original value; other original missing statuses map to null+mask1. Nonfinite value falsely taggedAVAILABLE is data integrity failure, not silently imputed.
missing.invalidMandatory: Invalid frozen v1 score/source identity => whole-run integrity failure before fit; invalid Risk status/value => explicit INPUT_INVALID/SKIP at the fixed anchor, no retry.
missing.unseenMissingBit: At evaluation mask1 unseen in that feature FIT rows => UNSUPPORTED_MISSING_STATE/SKIP at the fixed anchor; shadow opportunity latch is still consumed. No fallback v1.
missing.scaling: After fold-local weighted median imputation, weighted population mean/std on exactly2 raw predictors; normalize these2 only. Flags stay0/1. Zero/nonfinite raw variance fails fit. Statistics from eligible actual FIT prefix only.
missing.statusNoTimeFill: Missing indicators encode original source status before any label join; true0 value with AVAILABLE stays observed0, not missing.

model.lambdaRationale: Reuse v2 lambda1 with weighted-mean loss, normalized2 raw inputs and penalized indicators. No regularization search or evidence-based capacity rescue.
model.determinism: Stable sessionDate/decisionTimestamp/symbol/eventId order, fixed numeric dtype and thread env; no randomness, no shuffling/GPU. Identical pinned runtime must reproduce model/prediction hashes; cross-runtime comparison tolerance separately disclosed.
model.supportRationale: Retain prior numerical support guard7 labelled FIT rows,2 symbols; each raw predictor >=2 observed finite values and positive variance. Numerical feasibility is not statistical sufficiency. No support-driven fold redesign.
model.failure: Nonfinite input/parameters/objective, solver exception, residualInf>1e-10*(1+rhsInf), insufficient support or missing statistics => FIT_FAILED_NO_MODEL_NO_FALLBACK. No automatic alternative model.
model.nonnegativeReadout: Dhat=max(0,b+z@beta). Projection onto physical adverse magnitude domain, NOT percentile clipping or calibrated tail probability. Raw linear output retained for audit.
model.serialization: Canonical UTF8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false. Store feature order, target/contract SHA, training ID digest, dates/symbols, weights digest, medians, means/stds, mask support, intercept/coefficients and numerical residual. SHA-256 the payload excluding artifactSHA; exact hash check on reload.

decision.riskRule: At a valid frozen v1 shadow anchor only: Dhat<=tau => ENTER; otherwise SKIP_THIS_DECISION. Non-anchor always SKIP. No comparison to v1 E[L] magnitude beyond upstream2.0 gate.
decision.generation: Exactly the four previously precommitted P0 adverse severity landmarks, inherited without tiering/addition/interpolation. Not estimated from v2.1 outputs.
decision.selectionScope: Each chronological or symbol-complement inner calibration only; fit statistics from earlier innerFit. Freeze selected tau before outer refit/OOF.
decision.selectionRationale: With exact fixed anchors, larger tau monotonically retains more baseline opportunities. Once all precommitted risk/quality gates pass, prefer minimal intervention rather than minimize D30 further. This new v2.1 rule is fixed before any fit/prediction; it is not the v2 min-mean rule.
decision.selectionEligibility: All7 primary Entry gates and absoluteStrictLabelCoverageGapMax must be defined and PASS on inner calibration. No Portfolio/concentration/outer/group outcome used for tau.

metrics.sets: For each fixed evaluation window, B=all frozen v1 anchors; A=actual v2.1 accepted anchors, required A subset B; L=saved strict30m labelable mask. All metrics use the same window; runtime sets formed before label joins.
metrics.meanD30: Mean actual D30 on A intersect L, divided by mean on B intersect L. Arithmetic event-weighted evaluation; not training symbol weights.
metrics.ES95D30: Mean largest ceil(.05*N) observed D30 values, N>0, on each arm own strict set; compare ratio. No interpolation/drop-tail clipping.
metrics.precisionK: For k1,2,3,5: count(accepted and labelable and MFE>=k)/count(accepted and labelable). Unknown labels not counted as losers.
metrics.winnerRetentionK: count(A intersect L with MFE>=k)/count(B intersect L with MFE>=k). Exact same Entry time/price/window; no new recoveries. Baseline retention=1 when denominator>0. Undefined without baseline winners.
metrics.legacyPreservation: First-Selector original-window admission/timely/remaining-opportunity and its v1-relative ratio remain separately named DIAGNOSTICS. They are not the primary v1-anchor retention denominator; do not compare the two as identical rates.
metrics.throughput: count(A)/count(B) before labelability/allocation; same sessions including zero-entry days for ENTER/session.
metrics.coverage: abs(count(A intersect L)/count(A) - count(B intersect L)/count(B)); missing remains unknown. Report reasons and worst/best opportunity bounds separately.
metrics.entrySymbolHHI: sum_s (entryCount_s/totalEntryCount)^2 on each own all-anchor set; positive/negative PnL HHI not substituted.
metrics.macroSymbolMeanD30: For each arm, compute mean D30 per symbol having>=1 labelable accepted anchor, then arithmetic mean across those symbols, inherited from v2. Never impute a mean for a symbol with no accepted labels. Disclose per-arm symbol denominators and baseline symbols entirely rejected; paired common-symbol mean is a separate diagnostic. Macro changes include composition; alone they do not prove cross-symbol generalization.
metrics.riskSeparation: On stitched chronological OOF: mean actual D30 of DIRECT_RISK_VETO labelable anchors minus mean of accepted labelable anchors; input-invalid/unsupported-missing skips kept separate. At least1 in both groups needed for a defined comparison; this is not statistical sufficiency.
metrics.unweightedAndMacro: Report event-level and equal-symbol metrics side by side; training weights never silently reused for portfolio/evaluation.
metrics.unknownPolicy: No epsilon denominator, future substitution or D30=0. Empty metric population/zero winner denominator => INCONCLUSIVE. Baseline burden0: nonworsening passes only candidate0; required10% improvement => INCONCLUSIVE.

numericGates.independentRationale: Retain v2 precommitted10% mean adverse reduction,10% opportunity/precision loss allowance,20% throughput loss allowance,5pp coverage allowance. Promote +1/+2 to Primary because preserving v1 Opportunity is the purpose. No loosening based on v2.1 results. Exact-anchor retention is a NEW explicitly versioned refinement metric, not a claim of identical v2 remaining-opportunity denominator. Stability uses a mathematical strict majority (floor(n/2)+1), giving3/4 chronological and3/5 hash groups; pooled direct risk separation must be nonnegative. Entry-count concentration uses inherited10% relative deterioration budget; no absolute HHI fit to observed values. These are research utility preferences, not statistically validated optimal limits.

applicationScopes.chronologicalOOF: 7 primary gates on stitched60-session OOF; all5 guardrail scalar constraints. Nonworse fold count requires all4 fold means defined;3/4 with candidate/baseline<=1.
applicationScopes.heldSymbolOOF: All crossSymbol gates on stitched20 replicas; meanD30 nonworse in>=3/5 groups, every group defined; macro over fixed baseline symbol set. No targeted-symbol selection; no full-stack OOS claim.

numericGates.zeroUnknown: Undefined required primary/guard/cross metric => no PASS. No reweighting/rebalancing to remove weak or unknown groups. Risk-reject evidence absent means separation guard INCONCLUSIVE, not automatic PASS.
numericGates.verdictLogic: Technical/source/fit/selected-OOF incomplete => MSH_ENTRY_LONG_V2_1_DEVELOPMENT_BLOCKED. With complete OOF, any known required Entry/guard/cross failure => FAIL (report unknowns too); all required defined PASS => DEVELOPMENT_PASS with verdictScope ENTRY_REFINEMENT_ONLY; otherwise BLOCKED. Portfolio status is separate and remains UNKNOWN when unresolved. No automatic candidate/Fresh promotion.
